sub_site: peripheral whole blood of periodontitis patients before/after periodontal treatment

evidence.quote: Bacterial genomic DNA was extracted from 200 ul of whole blood using a commercial kit
targeting the V3-V4 region of the 16SrRNA gene
A total of 37 blood samples were selected (12 from Group A, 11 from Group B1, 14 from Group B2) for further high-throughput 16SrRNA gene sequencing

controls.types: extraction blank (ddH2O); nested PCR NTC (ddH2O) checked on gel

evidence.quote: Double distilled water was used as the negative control during the extraction process.
The negative control (double distilled water) yielded no PCR products

notes: 27 patients, 75 blood samples by nested PCR (semi-quantitative gel brightness only, not qPCR), 37 sequenced. Dominant blood genera named in Discussion (E0099) from own results; 'Cirtrobacter' is the paper's misspelling of Citrobacter. Fig 4B shows 23 most common genera (not named in text). Nested PCR increases contamination risk.
